# truenas_app (Resource)

Manages a TrueNAS custom app: a Docker Compose project that TrueNAS owns, so the Apps UI, lifecycle and status all work. Every change to a running app's compose restarts its containers. Catalog apps are refused; convert them with `app.convert_to_custom` first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_app" "plex" {
  name    = "plex"
  include = ["/mnt/tank/apps/docker/plex.yml"]

  portals = {
    "Web UI" = "http://plex.lan/"
    "Direct" = "http://192.0.2.10:32400/web"
  }
  notes = "Library at /mnt/tank/media."

  # Redeploy when the included compose file changes.
  redeploy_trigger = filesha256("${path.module}/stacks/plex.yml")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) App name: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, up to 40 characters. Changing it forces a new app.

### Optional

- `compose` (String) Compose YAML stored inline in TrueNAS. Compared by meaning, not text. Relative paths and `.env` resolve against TrueNAS's internal render directory; prefer `include` when they matter.
- `delete_images` (Boolean) Delete the app's images when destroying it. Off by default so locally built images survive.
- `delete_ix_volumes` (Boolean) Delete TrueNAS-managed ix volumes when destroying the app. Host paths are never touched.
- `desired_state` (String) `RUNNING` or `STOPPED`. Stopping removes the containers; volumes and images stay.
- `hold` (Boolean) Refuse any plan that would change, redeploy, restart or destroy the app, while still refreshing it. For stateful apps that are rolled out by hand. Setting it back to `false` is always allowed.
- `include` (List of String) Absolute paths of compose files on TrueNAS to include. The files are not managed here; `.env` interpolation and relative paths resolve against each file's directory.
- `notes` (String) Markdown notes shown in the Apps UI. Read only when an app is created, so changing them replaces the app.
- `portals` (Map of String) Links shown in the Apps UI, name to URL, e.g. `{ "Web UI" = "http://plex.lan/" }`. TrueNAS reads them only when an app is created, so changing them replaces the app.
- `redeploy_trigger` (String) Any value; changing it redeploys the app without changing its configuration. Use `filesha256()` of included compose files that are shipped outside Terraform.

### Read-Only

- `state` (String) State reported by TrueNAS: `RUNNING`, `DEPLOYING`, `STOPPED`, `STOPPING` or `CRASHED`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = truenas_app.example
  provider = truenas
  id       = "plex"
}
```
